name: Antonina Antonovna Nikitina
original_name: アントニーナ・アントーノヴナ・ニキーチナ
source:
Tonya is [url=/c281]Soushichi’s[/url] classmate and also a member of the student council. Being a Russian exchange student, she possesses silky silver hair and has a slightly more minute stature than the average. On the outside, an innocent(?) school girl but really she is a [spoiler]secret agent from Russia investigating in Jinyous of Japan[/spoiler].
Tonya possesses a calm, witty, analytical side [spoiler]that compliments her job as a spy[/spoiler] but also her snarky, playful and mischievous nature makes her a very rounded character. It’s probably not an exaggeration that most of her sharky side is in her fights with [url=/c297]Suzu[/url] (i.e. always). But how she teases Soushichi and [url=/c301]Keijirou[/url]/[url=/c331]Io[/url] about their romantic relation, her anger/jealous mode when someone tries to "advise" on her physique, in contrast to how she is always a reliable ally in combat and her kindness that is shown indirectly makes me think she is the best support any protagonist can get.

[Edited from [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2010/12/08/ayakashibito-review/]Warum's review[/url]]
